entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. It's completely useless to me and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is VF-8675309. And don't waste my time.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 17th. Okay, so I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? Are you kidding me? The issue is that I had a medical emergency right after I got it! I was in the hospital for weeks, I had to have unexpected surgery. It's been sitting in the box unopened. This isn't about preference, it's about not being able to use it at all.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that, Mark. I certainly hope you're on the road to a full recovery.

Look, just tell me if you're going to process the refund or not. If I get the runaround, I'm going straight to your manager and then I'm posting this whole disaster of a policy online. This is absurd.
I understand your frustration completely, and there's no need for that. Please just give me one moment to review our return policy details for your order.
Fine. But you have 30 seconds before I hang up and file a chargeback.

Thank you for holding, Mark. I've just checked our policy. It states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since your order was delivered on December 17th, you're only on day 36. You are well within the return window.
Oh. So... it's fine then? You'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I can process a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should receive it within the next five minutes. Just attach that to the box and drop it at the post office.
Okay. Well... that's what I expected. So the label is on its way?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with, Mark?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
